verdict.rationale: A government online business-filing portal could plausibly offer a built-in AI assistant or chatbot, so the axis applies. The evidence pack documents only online filings, searches, text/email notifications, a contact page, and step-by-step videos. None of it shows an AI assistant that users can delegate tasks to.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can delegate tasks to a built-in AI assistant inside the product
